rows.name: Sandie's Creations
rows.notes: Only found on the organizer's vendor list for the Aug 8, 2026 JCCH Craft & Collectibles Fair in Honolulu. That list is the evidence it was active in Aug 2026, and the listed event has already passed. I found no own Instagram, Facebook or website. Similarly named pages (Sandi's Creations on Facebook, Sandy's Creations florist, a Sandie's Creations YouTube page) could not be tied to this Oʻahu vendor, so I left the handles null. The side value comes from the directory seed (Town/Honolulu), not from the vendor's own source.

rows.name: Tiare Creations
rows.notes: Likely the same business as 'Tiare Creations by Serena Lee', a booth (Ste 58) at 333 Ward Ave, Honolulu. It sells Tahitian black pearl jewelry. Only third-party directory and gift-card listings and a review-site listing turned up. I did not use the review site and gave no source_url, because the only sources were directories and review sites. I found no own social accounts or website, and no date to show it is current. Tiare Hawaii (tiarehawaii.com) and Tiare Teiti are different businesses and were not used. The side value comes from the directory seed.

rows.name: Tide Pool Bangles
rows.notes: The Instagram bio describes handmade Hawaiian sea shell and resin bangles, gives its location as Kahaluu, HI, and says to DM for inquiries. Kahaluʻu is on the windward side. I could not confirm how recently it posted (the snippet showed 29 posts), so still_active is null. No Facebook page or website found. tidepoolhawaii.com is a different gold vermeil jewelry brand and was not used.

rows.name: Y's made
rows.notes: Listed as 'Y's made - Feather and Lace -' on the organizer's Aug 2026 JCCH Craft & Collectibles Fair vendor list. It also appears on the Oct 2025 and Nov 2025 JCCH lists. That is the evidence it was active in Aug 2026. I found no own Instagram, Facebook or website. The side value comes from the directory seed.

rows.name: YuYu Crafted
rows.notes: The Honolulu Festival organizer page gives 'FB: YuYu Crafted' and 'IG: yuyucrafted' for this business. It describes hand crafted and embroidered items made in Hawaii. The Facebook page posts craft fair stops (for example Mililani Uka Elementary, 5/4/25). Honolulu Magazine listed it at a late-2025 holiday craft fair, which is the most recent activity I saw. The Instagram URL is built from the handle the organizer gave. Its location is unclear, since its fairs were in Mililani, Waialua and Honolulu, so side is null. No website found.

rows.name: Zenga
rows.notes: Listed on the organizer's JCCH Craft & Collectibles Fair vendor lists for Oct 2025, Nov 2025 and Aug 2026. That is the evidence it was active in Aug 2026. A LinkedIn result suggests it upcycles vintage kimono into clothing, but I did not use a personal profile. I found no own Instagram, Facebook or website. ZEGNA (the Italian luxury menswear brand at Ala Moana) is unrelated. The side value comes from the directory seed.

rows.name: 808 Plant Designs
rows.notes: The site is an online shop selling air plants in ceramic and anime-themed vases. An Eventeny profile with the same name lists Pearl City, HI and the Kawaii Kon 2024 and 2025 fairs in Honolulu. That conflicts with the seed's Windward, so side is null. The website itself does not state a location, so the link between the site and the Eventeny profile rests on the name and products. No social accounts found. Current activity is not confirmed.

rows.name: Bloom Beaute Studio
rows.notes: The owner's link-in-bio page is titled 'Bloom Beaute Studio @bloombeaute' and says 'Hawai'i Grown'. It offers a shop, treatment booking and training courses. The Instagram handle comes from that title. The website domain showed a 'Bloom Beauté Studio' payment-plans page, and the root URL is inferred from that. No page I saw states Kapolei or Ewa, so the side value comes from the directory seed. Whether the business is current, and whether it sells at markets, is not confirmed. No Facebook page found. Bloom Beauty Studios (NY) and Bloom studio coworking (France) are different businesses.

rows.name: Bow Wow Kaukau
rows.notes: The Facebook page describes 'homemade, fresh, local food for the dogs of Oahu' and lists bowwowkaukau.com. A post says they are at Windward Mall upstairs every Sunday 10-2. That post is undated, so I cannot confirm it is current. The website snapshot I found is very old and says its ingredients are grown on Kauai. Because of that and the undated posts, still_active is null. No Instagram found. 808 Bow Wow (808bow-wow.com) is a different Honolulu dog-treat business.

rows.name: Brick Buy Brick
rows.notes: The Facebook page 'Brick buy Brick' is in Kaneohe, HI and sells new and used Lego, minifigures and sets. It lists a BrickLink store link and the email legoletGod@gmail.com. A directory listing gives instagram.com/legoletgod as the business's web address. The Hawaii business registry shows Brick Buy Brick L.L.C. as active, and directories list a shop at 46-005 Kawa St Ste 305, Kaneohe. This conflicts with the seed's Town/Honolulu, so I used windward. I did not use the review site. I found no own website. Shop hours were not taken from an official source.

rows.name: Cactus Cliff
rows.notes: My search returned nothing for this vendor, only unrelated cactus gardens. No accounts or sites could be tied to this business. The side value comes from the directory seed.

rows.name: Growing Creations
rows.notes: This is a potted plant, orchid, herb and cactus vendor. It is listed on the Hawaii Farm Bureau KCC Farmers' Market page (Kapiʻolani Community College), a page that showed as updated about 73 days ago. That listing is the evidence it is active. The listing gives the email growingc@hawaii.rr.com. A Waimānalo address (41-558 Makakalo St) appears as the home base and is 'not open to the public'. A YouTube video describes it as a nursery in Waianae. Because of that conflict and the Honolulu market location, side is null. An old X account (@growingcreation) exists but was not used. No Instagram, Facebook or website found.

rows.name: Incoco
rows.notes: The only 'Incoco' I found is the nail polish strip brand (Color Street's parent company), sold on Amazon, Etsy and eBay. A Mercari listing says it is no longer distributed in the US. I found nothing tying this brand to an Oʻahu vendor, so I assigned no accounts. The seed may mean a local reseller or a different business with the same name. The side value comes from the directory seed.

rows.name: It's About Time
rows.notes: This business sells moisture-wicking graphic t-shirts printed in Honolulu, at 1020 Auahi St Ste 5. The home page has a 'Where to find us' list of fairs (Koko Marina and JCCH, Jan-Mar dates) and asks people to call or text to confirm. It also appears on the Aug 2026 JCCH list and the Dec 2025 Hawaii Holiday Fair list. The site links to an Instagram account, but the handle was not visible in the results, so instagram is null. The site says remaining inventory and 'seconds' are being sold at discounted prices. That could mean it is winding down, so check before relying on it. The shop page showed no online checkout, so order_url is null. No Facebook page found.

rows.name: Kissy
rows.notes: I could not research this vendor because I ran out of searches. The name is also very generic, so no accounts are assigned. The side value comes from the directory seed.
